paragraphs: Rabbah bar Hiyya Ketosfa'ah. He performed halitzah before Shmuel, who said, ‘How great is his strength!’ Yevamot 104a; see Hiyya Ketosfa'ah. In Rabbah's name: Bava Batra 93, end of b; Rif and Asheri, however, have ‘in Rav's name.’ See Beitzah 38b. In Jerusalem Talmud, Kilayim, beginning of chapter 2, this matter has R' Yaakov bar Aha, Abba bar Hiyya in Rav's name. Heilprin cites Rav Sherira Gaon via Yuhasin: during the years when Abbah bar Nahmani was at Pumbedita, Rabbah bar Hiyya taught Torah publicly in Sura. The checked Epistle reads Rabbah bar Nahmani.
